senses.definition_en: video game console

examples.english: The minors asked him for video game consoles, video games, or cell phones. […] In these cases, he used different methods to gain their trust: with his dog, giving them candy or money or inviting them over to have a snack or to play with the video game console.
examples.ref: 2015 October 16, Sergio Lillo, “Detenido un supuesto pederasta que actuaba desde hace 15 años”, in El País, archived from the original on 18 Oct 2015:
examples.text: Los menores le pedían videoconsolas, videojuegos o teléfonos móviles. […] En estos casos utilizaba distintos métodos para ganarse su confianza: con su perro, regalándoles golosinas o dinero o invitándoles a merendar o a jugar con la videoconsola para conseguir que fueran a su domicilio.
examples.translation: The minors asked him for video game consoles, video games, or cell phones. […] In these cases, he used different methods to gain their trust: with his dog, giving them candy or money or inviting them over to have a snack or to play with the video game console.
